units.delivery:
Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
Pronounce the complete word centrifugal clearly in the rejection clause; do not replace it with centrifical. Keep D E and D E R as distinct letter sequences. Do not speak these instructions.
